scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && tsc -p tsconfig.handler.json
scripts.lint: oxlint src demo examples scripts test vite.config.ts vite.demo.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.fmt: oxfmt src demo examples scripts test vite.config.ts vite.demo.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.lib.json tsconfig.handler.json oxlint.json .fallowrc.json .pre-commit-config.yaml
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check src demo examples scripts test vite.config.ts vite.demo.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.lib.json tsconfig.handler.json oxlint.json .fallowrc.json .pre-commit-config.yaml
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.build:pages: pnpm build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/build-pages.ts && vite build --config vite.demo.config.ts && pnpm --dir docs build
